column3: The saddle agent and returner's pronouns require contextual interpretation; no extra prophetic description is inserted from another version.

column3: Preserved/saved reflects sōthōsi without a supplied mechanism or claim about resurrection; the selected purpose clause is not omitted.

column3: The precise subject of filled his hand, Jeroboam or the willing candidate, remains unresolved; the inherited consecrated wording does not claim an apparatus solution.

column3: The two royal summaries are preserved without harmonizing their ages, reigns or maternal naming.
